The '''Imperial prison camp''' was established by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum]]. It housed captured Republic prisoners during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial prison camp appears as an area on Ilum in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
